params.name: supportedService
params.description: Filter test definitions by supported service. Returns test definitions that either have an empty supportedServices list (supporting all services) or include the specified service.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Filter by enabled status (true/false). If not specified, returns all test definitions.

items.docs: Get a list of test definitions, optionally filtered by `service` it belongs to. Use `fields` parameter to get only necessary fields. Use cursor-based pagination to limit the number entries in the list using `limit` and `before` or `after` query params.
Create a test definition, if it does not exist, or update an existing test definition.
